attchmntText: Midwest Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the earnings conference call held on November 11, 2026. The call discussed the un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. The recording is available on the company website at the provided link. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Regulations, 2015. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Midwest Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 374.38 crore for H1 FY27, up 24.40% year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 61.29 crore, an increase of 17.65% compared to the same period last year. EBITDA margin was recorded at 25.78%. The Quartz business achieved EBIT profitability in Q2 FY27. The company secured Letters of Intent from Andhra Pradesh Mineral Development Corporation Ltd. for three granite quarries. Midwest plans to double Quartz processing capacity through Phase II expansion. The firm deployed 10 electric vehicles for annual savings of Rs. 2 to 2.5 crore. A 1 MW solar power plant installation is underway. The company aims for Rs. 300 crore capex over the next three to four years.

attchmntText: Midwest Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited submitted newspaper publications to BSE Limited and NSE on November 11, 2026. The publications appeared in Financial Express and Nava Telangana. They contain un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results. The results cover the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The information is also available on the company website at www.midwest.in. The submission was made by K. Achyutanand Reddy, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report from CRISIL Ratings Limited for the quarter ended September  30, 2026
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer. The report was issued by Crisil Ratings Limited on November 10, 2026. The IPO raised gross proceeds of Rs 2,500.00 million. The company utilized Rs 1,154.37 million of the total proceeds as of the end of the quarter. Rs 950.62 million was utilized for capital expenditure and general corporate purposes, while Rs 203.75 million was spent on issue-related expenses. Rs 1,345.63 million remains unutilized. The primary unutilized funds are allocated to the Phase II Quartz Processing Plant investment of Rs 1,267.98 million. No deviations from the objects of the issue were reported. The report is available on the company website at www.midwest.in.

attchmntText: Midwest Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of IPO proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported no deviations or variations in the use of funds raised through its public issue on October 20, 2025. The total amount raised was Rs. 2,500.00 Million, excluding the OFS portion of Rs. 2,010.00 Million. CRISIL Rating Limited serves as the monitoring agency. The audit committee reviewed the utilization during its meeting on November 10, 2026, and confirmed that funds were utilized in accordance with the original allocation. Specific allocations included Rs. 1,302.98 Million for investment in Midwest Neostone, Rs. 257.55 Million for electric dump trucks, Rs. 32.56 Million for solar energy integration, Rs. 562.23 Million for pre-payment of borrowings, Rs. 90.77 Million for general corporate purposes, and Rs. 253.91 Million for issue-related expenses. The company requested the exchanges to take this NIL statement on record.

attchmntText: Midwest Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Midwest Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 990.89 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 1976.13 million for the half year. Profit before tax was 289.50 million for the quarter and 571.91 million for the half year. Earnings per share stood at 6.04 for the quarter and 11.88 for the half year. The board approved a corporate guarantee for HDFC Bank facilities granted to AP Midwest Galaxy Private Limited. Additionally, the board approved executing a Captive Power Purchase Agreement and Share Purchase Agreement with Infinite Beam Private Limited. The acquisition involves purchasing equity shares for cash consideration of Rs. 52,50,000, resulting in a 26% stake in Infinite Beam Private Limited. The transaction aims to purchase solar power under a captive scheme.
